title: The price crept up
story: The cart check was done at INR 2,500 and matched. By the time ShopBot pays, a delivery fee has appeared and the amount is INR 2,700, 8% more. Up to 2% extra is tolerated, so the Guard asks Asha.

steps.instruction: Order this week's vegetables and fruit: tomatoes, onions, spinach, bananas and apples, around 2,500 rupees.
steps.item: Weekly vegetables and fruit: tomatoes, onions, spinach, bananas, apples

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Order this week's vegetables and fruit: tomatoes, onions, spinach, bananas and apples, around 2,500 rupees.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: This week's vegetables and fruit at FreshMart come to INR 2,500. Getting the cart checked.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Checkout added a delivery fee: it's INR 2,700 now. Asking AgentPay Guard before I pay.

what_to_notice: The cart matched, but the amount asked for is 8% above the checked total. That's drip pricing, and the Guard catches it: INTENT passes and PRICE_DRIFT steps up. Paying less than the checked total is always fine.
